en.title: Integrated Harness
en.description: The harness combines system instructions, tools, memory, teams, background work, cron, worktrees, and MCP.

steps.content: Prepare this project for release. Check the code, update the docs, and report deployment readiness.
steps.annotation: One ordinary request needs several earlier capabilities to work together.

steps.content: assemble_prompt: memory + task graph + skills + available tools + policy
steps.annotation: The runtime builds the prompt from layered sources of context.

steps.content: I suggest a docs teammate while I run the release checks and inspect deployment status. Shall I start that team?
steps.annotation: The Lead proposes the team before adding another persistent agent.

steps.content: Yes. Start the docs teammate and continue.
steps.annotation: User confirmation opens the team boundary inherited from S13.

steps.content: {"name":"code-review"}
steps.annotation: Skills contribute procedural context before execution.

steps.content: {"subject":"Update release notes","description":"Prepare release documentation and report the result."}
steps.annotation: The shared task board gives the docs work a stable owner and lifecycle.

steps.content: Created task_1712345678_0042: Update release notes
steps.annotation: The task ID connects the assignment to its working directory.

steps.content: {"name":"release-docs","task_id":"task_1712345678_0042"}
steps.annotation: The pending docs task receives a separate checkout before it is claimed.

steps.content: Worktree 'release-docs' created for task_1712345678_0042
steps.annotation: The task now carries the checkout used by its eventual owner.

steps.content: {"name":"docs","role":"documentation engineer","prompt":"Claim task_1712345678_0042, update the release notes in its task-bound worktree, and report the result."}
steps.annotation: Team delegation handles a parallel slice of the release.

steps.content: {"command":"python -m unittest tests.test_agent_teams_runtime","run_in_background":true}
steps.annotation: Long-running validation goes through the background task path.

steps.content: permission: user approved the exact test command
steps.annotation: Team confirmation does not authorize shell execution; the foreground turn asks separately before dispatch.

steps.content: {"name":"deploy"}
steps.annotation: External capabilities are added only when needed.

steps.content: {"service":"web"}
steps.annotation: Connecting discovers the tool; a separate call performs the status check.

steps.content: [deploy] web: running (v1.4.2)
steps.annotation: The readiness statement now comes from the MCP tool result rather than the connection event.

steps.content: task_notification(status=completed): tests passed; teammate result and deploy status appended
steps.annotation: The integrated runtime folds asynchronous results back into the loop.

steps.content: Release preparation is ready: checks passed, docs are updated in the teammate worktree, and deployment status is available.
steps.annotation: The integrated harness returns a single user-facing outcome.

nl.title: Integrated Harness
nl.description: De harness combineert system instructions, tools, memory, teams, achtergrondwerk, cron, worktrees en MCP.

steps.content: Bereid dit project voor op release. Check de code, werk de docs bij en rapporteer deployment-gereedheid.
steps.annotation: Eén gewone vraag vraagt meerdere eerdere mechanismen samen te werken.

steps.content: assemble_prompt: memory + task graph + skills + beschikbare tools + policy
steps.annotation: De runtime bouwt de prompt uit gelaagde contextbronnen.

steps.content: Ik stel een docs-teammate voor terwijl ik release-checks draai en de deploymentstatus bekijk. Zal ik dat team starten?
steps.annotation: De Lead stelt het team voor vóór er een persistente agent bij komt.

steps.content: Ja. Start de docs-teammate en ga door.
steps.annotation: Gebruikersbevestiging opent de teamgrens uit S13.

steps.content: {"name":"code-review"}
steps.annotation: Skills leveren procedurele context vóór uitvoering.

steps.content: {"subject":"Update release notes","description":"Prepare release documentation and report the result."}
steps.annotation: Het gedeelde taskboard geeft docs-werk een stabiele eigenaar en lifecycle.

steps.content: Created task_1712345678_0042: Update release notes
steps.annotation: Het task-ID koppelt de toewijzing aan de werkdirectory.

steps.content: {"name":"release-docs","task_id":"task_1712345678_0042"}
steps.annotation: De pending docs-taak krijgt een aparte checkout vóór claim.

steps.content: Worktree 'release-docs' created for task_1712345678_0042
steps.annotation: De taak draagt nu de checkout die de latere eigenaar gebruikt.

steps.content: {"name":"docs","role":"documentation engineer","prompt":"Claim task_1712345678_0042, update the release notes in its task-bound worktree, and report the result."}
steps.annotation: Teamdelegatie pakt een parallelle plak van de release.

steps.content: {"command":"python -m unittest tests.test_agent_teams_runtime","run_in_background":true}
steps.annotation: Langlopende validatie gaat via het achtergrondpad.

steps.content: permission: gebruiker keurde het exacte testcommando goed
steps.annotation: Teambevestiging autoriseert geen shell; de foreground-beurt vraagt apart vóór dispatch.

steps.content: {"name":"deploy"}
steps.annotation: Externe capabilities worden pas toegevoegd wanneer nodig.

steps.content: {"service":"web"}
steps.annotation: Verbinden ontdekt de tool; een aparte aanroep doet de statuscheck.

steps.content: [deploy] web: running (v1.4.2)
steps.annotation: De gereedheidsuitspraak komt uit het MCP-toolresultaat, niet uit het connect-event.

steps.content: task_notification(status=completed): tests geslaagd; teammate-resultaat en deploy-status toegevoegd
steps.annotation: De geïntegreerde runtime vouwt asynchrone resultaten terug in de loop.

steps.content: Releasevoorbereiding is klaar: checks geslaagd, docs bijgewerkt in de teammate-worktree, en deploy-status is running.
steps.annotation: De geïntegreerde harness geeft één gebruikersuitkomst terug.
